title: Slowpath telemetry sidecar: trace annotation + inference KPI translation
creator: Maya Rodriguez
description: Problem: We lack deterministic instrumentation for slow-path events inside the inference runtime (KV cache misses, long decode loops, kernel fallback). These events are currently visible only in logs and occasional traces, making SLO alerting and per-tenant cost attribution noisy. Goal: Build a lightweight telemetry sidecar that hooks into the serving runtime to (1) emit OTel span annotations for slowpath events and function-level timings, and (2) translate internal inference KPIs (token_cost_estimate, kv_cache_miss_rate, gen_iteration_count) into both OTLP metrics and a Prometheus-compatible exposition for our metrics pipeline. The sidecar must be tenant-aware, support adaptive sampling (to avoid high-cardinality storms), and allow runtime configuration toggles via flags in the service config. Non-goals: full tracing re-architecture, heavy-weight per-token logs, or changing runtime scheduling decisions.
acceptance_criteria: OTel spans emitted per request include 'slowpath=true' when KV cache miss threshold exceeded (>=2 misses per request)
Prometheus exposition endpoint available on the sidecar (metrics scraped by prometheus-agent) with stable metric names and labels matching our canonical schema
Sidecar exports OTLP metrics that map internal KPI names to stable metric names (e.g., inference.token_cost_estimate -> redwood.inference.token_cost_estimate) with tenant_id label
Adaptive sampler reduces exported spans/metrics for tenants over a configurable QPS threshold and is configurable via feature flag
Automated dashboard panels added to latency/error dashboard that surface slowpath rate and token_cost_estimate histogram per model
Code reviewed and e2e tests covering event detection, correct labels, and sampling logic merged (PR + test run in CI)
updates: 2025-01-10 - Ticket created by Maya: initial scope and motivation. Pitched lightweight sidecar approach to avoid invasive runtime changes.

2025-01-15 - Spike complete: implemented prototype that reads runtime event stream and emits OTLP spans. Found two tricky cases: event order for multi-shard requests and tenant label propagation for pooled workers.

2025-01-20 - Architecture sync with Infra and Runtime (notes in Confluence, link below). Decided to attach trace annotations at span boundaries rather than rewrite trace ids. Trade-off: simpler integration vs slightly delayed annotation when request fans out.
2025-01-24 - Iteration: added Prometheus exposition on sidecar; metrics schema drafted and shared with observability team for feedback.

2025-01-28 - Design review feedback from SRE (Jonas) and Observability PM (Priya): require a backpressure mode for sidecar when event backlog grows. Added backlog cap + drop policy and observable metric for drops.
2025-02-02 - Working on e2e tests for sampling and label correctness. Implemented tenant-aware consistent hashing to reduce label-cardinality spikes; running local perf benchmarks (results attached).
